items.title: Why Is Everforth (EFOR) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
items.summary: Shares of IT services provider Everforth (EFOR) jumped 14.6% in the morning session after Truist Securities upgraded the stock to 'Buy' from 'Hold' and raised its price target. The price target was increased to $36 from $33. The upgrade was driven by expectations for growth in the company's commercial consulting services during the second and third quarters.
